name: Failed login burst followed by success (credential compromise)
input: A RULE-001 match plus subsequent login_success events for the same user_id/source_ip pair.

condition.description: A RULE-001 brute-force match is followed, within 10 minutes of the last failed attempt, by a login_success for the same user_id from the same source_ip.

evidence_template: Successful login for user {user_id} from the same source at {success_ts}, {gap_seconds}s after the last failure
false_positives: Legitimate user succeeded on a later attempt after mistyping their own password several times.
Password manager autofill retried a stale cached credential before the current one.
